title: The Call Button in the Closed Hospital Wing Kept Ringing #shorts #horror
description: I worked nights guarding a hospital wing that closed years ago. Every night at 2 AM, room 14 pressed the call button. #shorts #horror #scary #creepy #horrorstory

hook.text: Room 14 has been empty for years.

lines.text: I took a night job guarding an old hospital wing.
It closed years ago. No patients. No power upstairs.
At two AM, the nurse's phone lit up.
The call light said room fourteen.
I went up with my flashlight. The room was empty.
The bed sheets were still warm.
The next night, it rang again. And the next.
So I unplugged the whole switchboard.
At two AM, someone knocked on the guard booth.
A thin voice said, nobody came when I called.
So I came down to you.
